name: Joash
overview: Joash was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Shelah, who was the son of Judah. His mention in Scripture is brief and primarily genealogical, with no additional notes or narrative details recorded.
namesAndTitles: The name Joash appears once in Scripture without a provided meaning or divine origin. It is simply presented as a proper name in 1 Chronicles 4:22, without further explanation or titles.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Joash as the son of Shelah, who himself was a son of Judah. Beyond this direct father-son relationship, no additional family connections are noted in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Joash's significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah, emphasizing the continuity of God's chosen lineage. Although little is detailed about his life or deeds, his mention upholds the biblical emphasis on heritage and the preservation of the covenant community through generations.
